desc:
Shopify discounts, sales and campaign setup means building your offer inside the store and testing it at checkout before customers see it. Ecom Swift LLC creates the codes, automatic discounts, banners and collection pages, then schedules the start and end.

## What is Shopify discount and campaign setup?

Shopify discount and campaign setup is the work of turning a sales idea into working rules in your store. You decide the offer, such as a seasonal sale or a first-order code. We build the discount, set who and what it applies to, and make the storefront announce it clearly.

A discount that exists in the admin is only half a campaign. Shoppers also need to see the offer, understand it and have it apply at checkout without confusion.

## Why a sale that is set up carelessly costs money

Discount rules interact in ways that surprise store owners. A code meant for one collection can apply to everything. A minimum spend can be met by items that were never meant to count. A sale with no end date can keep running after the season is over. Each mistake means either lost margin or angry customers who see one price on a page and another at checkout.

Timing is just as important. A banner that goes live an hour late, or a code that expires at the wrong time zone boundary, can break a campaign that took weeks to plan. Careful setup and a scheduled start and end remove that risk.

## How good campaign setup improves results

A clear offer reduces hesitation. When a shopper sees a banner, a sale collection and a matching discount at checkout, the message is consistent, and the decision to buy feels low risk. When the banner says one thing and the cart says another, trust falls and the cart is abandoned.

Structure matters too. Automatic discounts remove the need to type a code, which helps shoppers on a phone. Codes work better when you want to track a channel or reward a group. Buy X get Y and tiered offers can raise the size of an order, because the shopper can see the next step up. The outcome of any campaign still depends on your products, prices and traffic, so we focus on building the offer correctly.

## What a well-built campaign includes

- Discount codes or automatic discounts with clear, readable names.
- Rules that name the exact products or collections that qualify.
- Minimum spend or quantity conditions where the offer needs them.
- Start and end dates scheduled in advance.
- Usage limits per customer or in total where you want them.
- A sale banner and an announcement bar that match the offer wording.
- A sale collection page that lists only the products on offer.
- Test orders at checkout for each discount, on phone and desktop.
- A short guide for turning each offer off if you need to stop early.

## What we do

We begin with a short conversation about the offer: which products, which dates, who qualifies and what the price should be at checkout. We then build each discount in your Shopify admin and write down its rules in plain words.

Next we place test orders for every discount and check the cart, the checkout total and the confirmation email. On the Standard package we add the banner, announcement bar and sale collection page, and we schedule the start and end. Premium adds Buy X get Y and tiered offers, two promo email drafts and a clean-up after the sale ends, so old banners, codes and sale prices do not linger.

## What to do and what to avoid

**Do:**
- Decide the products, dates and rules before the build starts.
- Write the offer in one short sentence and use it everywhere.
- Test every code with a real cart on your own phone.
- Set an end date at the time you create the sale.
- Check that your sale prices still meet the pricing rules in the countries you sell to.

**Avoid:**
- Stacking several offers without checking how they combine.
- Leaving a sale banner up after the discount has ended.
- Using a code name that customers can easily guess and share.
- Applying a discount to the whole store when only a collection was planned.
- Launching a campaign without a test order.

## Who this is for

This service suits owners planning a seasonal sale who want it to run smoothly without learning every discount setting. It suits stores that need a first-order code or a loyalty offer for returning customers, and it suits sellers who ran a sale before and found that the wrong prices appeared at checkout.

## What we need from you

Tell us the offer, the products or collections, the dates and any conditions. Send a collaborator or staff invitation to your store, and share any banner wording or images you already have. We never need your password. We do not run ads for the sale, and promo email drafts are text for you to send from your own email tool. After you order, we confirm the plan in writing before we build.
